subject: IndigoTrust SIG: scope clarification and request for sample extracts
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@indigotrust.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@indigotrust.com>, Indigotrust Security <security@indigotrust.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 09:14:03 -0700
Subject: IndigoTrust SIG questionnaire and sample artifact request

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for taking our RFP. We finished an initial pass on the SIG questionnaire and have a couple of follow-ups before we lock scope for procurement:

- We need a short mapping (control -> Redwood evidence location) for controls around key management, telemetry/traceability, and data retention.
- For KMS/key provenance we require a sample (redacted) artifact that demonstrates key rotation history and proof of custody for the period Jan 2026 - Feb 2026.
- For telemetry we’d like a short sample (30‑minute window) of request-level traces showing request_id, model_id, region, and outcome codes (or an equivalent export).

Can you confirm whether the above can be produced as redacted artifacts? Also please share an expected delivery timeline and any preconfigured NDAs/PO terms we should route to our legal team.

We attached an updated SIG questionnaire (v2) with a few inline notes. If this is easier, we can book a 30-minute call this week to align.

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Senior Procurement Manager
IndigoTrust Financial
[Attachment: IndigoTrust_SIG_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@indigotrust.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 11:02:18 -0700
Subject: Re: IndigoTrust SIG questionnaire and sample artifact request

Ellen — thanks for the clear list. Looping in our security and controls team to scope artifacts and confirm redaction approach.

Quick answers up front:
- Control mapping: we’ll produce a CSV snapshot that maps SIG controls to Redwood internal evidence (docs, dashboards, logs).
- KMS/key provenance: we can provide a sealed PDF proof (signed by key custodian) and a redacted rotation log showing key IDs and rotation timestamps for the requested window.
- Telemetry: we can export a 30‑minute trace sample with pseudonymized request_ids.

Kimberly — can you confirm the format and whether we should include signer metadata for the KMS proof? Jordan/Mina/Jonas — please advise on timeline (we can aim for EOD Wed PT for initial artifacts).

If IndigoTrust prefers, we can send artifacts via your secure portal (DocuSign SFTP link was referenced in the RFP).

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0189
[Attachment: control-map-snapshot.csv (text/csv)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen.park@indigotrust.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 08:46:54 -0700
Subject: Re: IndigoTrust SIG questionnaire and sample artifact request

Hi team / Ellen — I reviewed the asks and propose the following artifact plan:

1) Control mapping (CSV) — includes: SIG control id, Redwood control owner, evidence type (doc/log/dash), retention policy link, sample artifact pointer. Will attach snapshot.

2) KMS/key provenance — deliverables:
   - redwood_kms_key_proof_sample.pdf: signed proof from our key custodian describing rotation policy, HSM/KMS provider, and a redacted rotation ledger for Jan–Feb 2026.
   - Note: we will not disclose raw private key material. The proof will include key IDs, rotation timestamps, and HMACs that can be used for validation.

3) Telemetry/trace sample — deliverables: 30-minute pseudonymized export (JSONL) with columns: request_id (hashed), model_variant, region, timestamp, status_code.

Open clarifying items for IndigoTrust:
- Is the rotation proof required to include the KMS provider ARN(s) and associated key aliases, or is a redacted alias acceptable?
- For telemetry, do you require raw prompt text for correspondence, or is request metadata sufficient?

Timeline suggestion: initial artifacts (CSV + sealed PDF + telemetry sample) by Wed 31 Mar EOD PT. If Ellen confirms the two clarifications above today, we’ll hit that target.

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Security Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_kms_key_proof_sample.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@indigotrust.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 10:22:11 -0700
Subject: Re: IndigoTrust SIG questionnaire and sample artifact request

Hi Kimberly / Hannah — thank you. A couple quick clarifications from IndigoTrust security:

- Redacted aliases are OK; we do need the provider identifiers (e.g., AWS KMS key ARN) redacted but a stable alias mapping so we can reconcile events with our ingest pipelines.
- For telemetry: metadata only is sufficient — we do not need raw prompts for this compliance pass. Please pseudonymize request_ids and do not include user-identifying fields.

We also need the key-proof to include the custodian name and a contact (for a witness attestation) — can you include that in the sealed PDF? If possible, please deliver artifacts to our secure portal: https://secure.indigotrust.com/upload (I’ve asked procurement to open an upload ticket).

We can sign an NDA — send over your standard PDF.

Best,
Ellen
Ellen Park
Senior Procurement Manager
IndigoTrust Financial
Procurement: procurement@indigotrust.com

- We’ll upload the control map CSV, the sealed KMS proof PDF (includes custodian name and contact), and the 30‑minute pseudonymized telemetry export to your portal by Mon 05 Apr 2027 17:00 PT.
- We’ll also attach a short README that explains redaction rules and verification instructions (HMAC verification steps for key rotation ledger).
- Legal: sending our standard mutual NDA as a DocuSign link now (see HubSpot/Contract record).

Action items:

- Jordan: generate telemetry export and pseudonymize request_ids.
- Mina/Jonas: finalize control-map-snapshot.csv and README.

Ellen — please confirm the upload ticket or portal credentials when available and we’ll begin the transfer. If IndigoTrust prefers a call, I’m available Mon 05 Apr 10–11am PT.

Thanks all — Hannah
